description: Be part of the campaign for Shaunie Cousins, candidate for Oregon House District 34. Whether you volunteer your time, contribute resources, or help spread the message, your support makes a difference. Together, we can bring accountability, affordability, public safety, and stronger education to Bethany, Cedar Mill, Oak Hills, and Beaverton.
